title: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition
title_zh: 通过并行适配器组合实现实时联合音视频生成

paragraphs.en: Deploying a joint audio–video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio–video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel . A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio–video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio–video in real time, ≈ 26 {\approx}26 fps at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 without quantization, and sustains 30 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality. Demo Page: https://pac-demo-2027.github.io/demo/
paragraphs.zh: 部署用于实时交互式生成的联合音频-视频扩散变换器通常需要两项关键修改：块自回归注意力机制，以便在整段视频生成完成前即可输出各帧；以及少步采样，以降低每个块的计算成本。 传统上，流式视频相关研究通过串联式流程来实现这两项能力。 该方法首先将双向教师模型蒸馏为因果学生模型，再进一步蒸馏为少步模型，或者按相反顺序进行。 这种链式结构的每个阶段都会微调前一阶段生成的权重，因此后续的目标函数可能会覆盖早期阶段的能力。 基于模型合并的思想，我们证明在紧凑的音频-视频主干网络上，这两项能力可以并行获得。 一个因果适配器在冻结的主干网络上进行训练，而一个现成的少步适配器则提供少步能力。 由于两者修改的是不同的功能轴，我们预测并验证了它们的权重更新方向接近正交，且训练过程中无需任何显式的正交性约束。 正交的更新应能相互无干扰地结合，因此并行组合相当于直接求和。 在推理时只需将两个适配器简单相加，无需联合训练，即可生成少步流式音频-视频，其图像质量能够追踪双向教师模型的表现。 与串联式基线模型相比，组合模型在多数指标上与之相当甚至更优，表明并行组合是一种实用的方法。 由此构建的流式系统能够实时生成联合音频-视频，在 480×832 分辨率下无需量化时可达约 26 fps，并能持续生成 30 秒内容且图像质量稳定。 演示页面：https://pac-demo-2027.github.io/demo/

paragraphs.en: Joint audio–video generation has matured quickly: recent models produce synchronized audio and video at high fidelity ( Liu et al., 2026 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ; Seedance Team, 2026 ) . Most of them, however, are bidirectional: the frame count must be fixed before sampling, nothing is emitted until the last step finishes, and every step costs quadratically in the requested duration. Applications built on real-time interaction ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) — interactive avatars, live agents — call for the opposite properties: a bounded time-to-first-frame, a per-chunk cost independent of session length, and no length ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 联合音频–视频生成技术已迅速成熟：近期模型能够以高保真度生成同步的音频和视频（Liu 等人，2026；HaCohen 等人，2026；MiniMax，2026；Seedance Team，2026）。 然而，其中大多数是双向的：采样前必须固定帧数，直到最后一步完成之前不会有任何输出，且每一步的成本与所需时长呈二次方关系。 基于实时交互的应用程序（Bai 等人，2026；Huang 等人，2026）——例如交互式虚拟形象、实时智能体——则需要相反的特性：有限的初始帧延迟、每段内容成本与会话长度无关，且没有时长上限。

paragraphs.en: Two capabilities are required. Causalization partitions the clip into chunks and denoises chunk k k from chunks 0 : k − 1 0{:}k{-}1 , so the outputs are emitted incrementally and a chunk is played as soon as it is ready. Few-step generation shrinks the per-chunk cost from tens of denoising steps to a handful, which is the key to real-time generation. Learning them may take several training stages, and each stage may train a single objective or both. CausVid and Self-Forcing ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) learn both under one distillation objective, training a causal few-step student directly from the bidirectional teacher. Causal Forcing and its successor ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) split the process, training a multi-step autoregressive model first and distilling it to few steps afterwards; OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026 ) runs the reverse order, converting a distilled bidirectional few-step generator into an autoregressive one. The split has its appeal: each stage optimizes a single objective rather than mixing several, can start from an existing checkpoint, and can be analyzed in isolation. But the training stages interact: whichever runs first changes the base the second trains on. We refer to the sequential recipes as chained in what follows.
paragraphs.zh: 需要两种能力。 因果化将剪辑片段划分为多个块，并对第 k 个块进行去噪，同时参考第 0 到 k−1 个块；因此输出是逐步生成的，每个块一旦准备就绪就会立即播放。 少步生成将每个块的计算成本从数十次去噪步骤压缩至仅几次，这是实现实时生成的关键。 学习这些能力可能需要多个训练阶段，每个阶段可能只训练单一目标，也可能同时训练两个目标。 CausVid 和 Self-Forcing（Yin 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2025）在单一蒸馏目标下同时学习两者，直接从双向教师模型中训练一个因果少步学生模型。 Causal Forcing 及其后续方法（Zhu 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026）将过程拆分：首先训练一个多步自回归模型，随后将其蒸馏为少步模型；而 OmniForcing（Su 等人，2026）则采用相反顺序，将蒸馏后的双向少步生成器转换为自回归模型。 这种拆分有其优势：每个阶段只需优化单一目标，而非混合多个目标；可以从现有的检查点开始训练；并且各阶段可以独立分析。 但这些训练阶段之间存在相互作用：先执行的阶段会改变第二阶段所基于的初始模型。 在下文中，我们将这类顺序执行的方法称为“链式方法”。

paragraphs.en: We follow the idea of splitting the learning of causalization and few-step distillation, and ask whether the chain is necessary to achieve the desired capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that it is not: the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel , by weight addition at inference. The principle is model merging / task arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) : updates fine-tuned independently against one frozen base can be added in weight space, in the small-edit regime, while each keeps its function. Our route does exactly this. The causal adapter Δ c \Delta_{c} is trained against the frozen W W with clean-context teacher forcing—a plain flow-matching regression, and the only objective we train. The few-step adapter Δ d \Delta_{d} is off the shelf, distilled under bidirectional attention where distillation is already solved. The two are then added at inference, with no joint or chained training, so neither stage ever sees a base the other has altered. Two chained baselines are included for comparison: Chained-DA (distill, then causalize) retrains the causal adapter on the distilled weights with the plain flow-matching regression, the same order as OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026 ) . Chained-AD (causalize, then distill) is the causal-forcing recipe ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . The differences between the three approaches can be seen in Figure 1 , and our recipe is denoted as Decoupled .

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. (1) Parallel composition works: the two adapters, trained independently against the one frozen backbone and simply added at inference, match the teacher on appearance and the single-frame distribution, and beat Chained-DA on most held-out metrics, while trailing Chained-AD on lip sync. There is no chained or joint training, none of the chains’ extra stages, and the causal adapter stays reusable across step counts and on both the undistilled and the distilled weights (§ 4.2 ). (2) A real-time streaming system from short-clip training: the composed model generates joint audio–video at ≈ 26 {\approx}26 fps at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 on six GPUs without quantization, and a causal adapter trained on 5 5 – 10 10 s clips extrapolates to stable 30 30 s generation, where Chained-DA decays and falls silent (§ 4.2 , Table 2 ). (3) A predicted, then verified, geometry: the two updates read overlapping input subspaces but write into near-orthogonal directions, so their sum needs no constraint, and weight cancellation is ruled out as Chained-DA ’s failure mode (§ 4.3 ). All comparisons share one pipeline and reference the teacher’s own generation (Table 1 ); the ordering carries over to three public benchmarks scored against real sources (§ 4.2 , Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面。 （1）并行组合有效：两个适配器独立训练，分别针对一个冻结的主干网络，并在推理时简单相加，其外观和单帧分布与教师模型一致，并且在大多数预留指标上优于 Chained-DA，但在唇部同步方面则落后于 Chained-AD。 不存在链式或联合训练，也没有任何链式结构的额外阶段，并且因果适配器在不同步数以及未蒸馏和蒸馏权重之间均可重复使用（§ 4.2）。 （2）基于短片段训练的实时流式系统：组合模型可在六块 GPU 上以 480 × 832 分辨率、约 26 {\approx}26 fps 的速度生成联合音频–视频，且无需量化；在 5 – 10 秒片段上训练的因果适配器能够外推至稳定的 30 秒生成，而 Chained-DA 则会衰减并静默（§ 4.2，表 2）。 （3）先预测、后验证的几何结构：两次更新读取重叠的输入子空间，但写入近乎正交的方向，因此它们的和无需任何约束，并且权重抵消已被排除为 Chained-DA 的失效模式（§ 4.3）。 所有比较均共享一条处理流程，并以教师模型自身的生成结果作为参考（表 1）；这一排序关系也延续到三个基于真实数据源评分的公开基准测试中（§ 4.2，附录 G）。

sents.en: Our contributions are threefold.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面。

sents.en: (1) Parallel composition works: the two adapters, trained independently against the one frozen backbone and simply added at inference, match the teacher on appearance and the single-frame distribution, and beat Chained-DA on most held-out metrics, while trailing Chained-AD on lip sync.
sents.zh: （1）并行组合有效：两个适配器独立训练，分别针对一个冻结的主干网络，并在推理时简单相加，其外观和单帧分布与教师模型一致，并且在大多数预留指标上优于 Chained-DA，但在唇部同步方面则落后于 Chained-AD。

sents.en: There is no chained or joint training, none of the chains’ extra stages, and the causal adapter stays reusable across step counts and on both the undistilled and the distilled weights (§ 4.2 ).
sents.zh: 不存在链式或联合训练，也没有任何链式结构的额外阶段，并且因果适配器在不同步数以及未蒸馏和蒸馏权重之间均可重复使用（§ 4.2）。

sents.en: (2) A real-time streaming system from short-clip training: the composed model generates joint audio–video at ≈ 26 {\approx}26 fps at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 on six GPUs without quantization, and a causal adapter trained on 5 5 – 10 10 s clips extrapolates to stable 30 30 s generation, where Chained-DA decays and falls silent (§ 4.2 , Table 2 ).
sents.zh: （2）基于短片段训练的实时流式系统：组合模型可在六块 GPU 上以 480 × 832 分辨率、约 26 {\approx}26 fps 的速度生成联合音频–视频，且无需量化；在 5 – 10 秒片段上训练的因果适配器能够外推至稳定的 30 秒生成，而 Chained-DA 则会衰减并静默（§ 4.2，表 2）。

sents.en: (3) A predicted, then verified, geometry: the two updates read overlapping input subspaces but write into near-orthogonal directions, so their sum needs no constraint, and weight cancellation is ruled out as Chained-DA ’s failure mode (§ 4.3 ).
sents.zh: （3）先预测、后验证的几何结构：两次更新读取重叠的输入子空间，但写入近乎正交的方向，因此它们的和无需任何约束，并且权重抵消已被排除为 Chained-DA 的失效模式（§ 4.3）。

sents.en: All comparisons share one pipeline and reference the teacher’s own generation (Table 1 ); the ordering carries over to three public benchmarks scored against real sources (§ 4.2 , Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 所有比较均共享一条处理流程，并以教师模型自身的生成结果作为参考（表 1）；这一排序关系也延续到三个基于真实数据源评分的公开基准测试中（§ 4.2，附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Video generation has been studied for years, but the focus has been mostly on the visual modality alone ( Yang and others, 2024 ; Kong and others, 2024 ; Wan Team, 2025 ) , with no accompanying audio. Audio-driven portrait animation ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ; Cui et al., 2024 ; Gan and others, 2025 ) couples the two, generating video conditioned on a driving audio track; the coupling is one-way, the video following the audio, which itself cannot be freely prompted. Generating both jointly is developing rapidly ( Liu et al., 2026 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) , the two modalities produced simultaneously by one model. LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) uses a two-tower structure, one tower per modality, with cross-attention sharing knowledge between the towers to keep the two synchronized. In Cosmos 3 and MiniMax-H3, audio and video tokens are arranged in a single sequence processed by one DiT.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成技术已研究多年，但主要关注点一直仅局限于视觉模态（Yang 等人，2024；Kong 等人，2024；Wan Team，2025），且没有配套的音频。 以音频驱动的人物动画（Prajwal 等人，2020；Cui 等人，2024；Gan 等人，2025）将两者结合，通过以驱动音频轨道为条件来生成视频；这种耦合是单向的，即视频跟随音频，而音频本身无法自由提示。 联合生成两者的技术正在快速发展（Liu 等人，2026；HaCohen 等人，2026；MiniMax，2026；NVIDIA，2026），即由单一模型同时生成两种模态。 LTX-2（HaCohen 等人，2026）采用双塔结构，每个模态对应一个塔，并通过跨注意力在两个塔之间共享知识，以保持两者同步。 在 Cosmos 3 和 MiniMax-H3 中，音频和视频标记被排列在一个单一序列中，由一个 DiT 统一处理。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and Rolling Diffusion ( Ruhe et al., 2024 ) apply per-position noise levels, so early positions with less noise are generated first. A family of later methods distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal few-step student. CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) initializes the causal student on the teacher’s ODE pairs, then refines it with asymmetric DMD. Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) additionally trains on the student’s own rollouts to close the train–test gap. Self-Forcing++ ( Cui et al., 2025 ) scales AR video generation to minute-long videos. OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026 ) is the closest work: it brings the same line to joint audio–video, but as a multi-stage chain that first distills a bidirectional few-step generator and then converts it to autoregressive, the order our Chained-DA instantiates in plain form. The recipe is involved, and that order is the weakest four-step system in Table 1 . Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) and its successor ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) run the stages in the reverse order, training a multi-step autoregressive model first and distilling it last with consistency and distribution-matching objectives on the student’s own rollouts; this is the recipe our Chained-AD follows. Others scale or extend chunkwise autoregression ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Henschel et al., 2024 ; Chen and others, 2025 ; Sand.ai, 2025 ) ; all are video-only except OmniForcing.
paragraphs.zh: Diffusion Forcing（Chen 等，2024）和 Rolling Diffusion（Ruhe 等，2024）采用逐位置噪声水平，因此噪声较少的早期位置会优先生成。 一系列后续方法将双向教师模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型。 CausVid（Yin 等，2025）首先在教师的 ODE 对上初始化因果学生模型，然后使用非对称 DMD 对其进行优化。 Self-Forcing（Huang 等，2025）还利用学生模型自身的生成结果进行训练，以缩小训练与测试之间的差距。 Self-Forcing++（Cui 等，2025）将 AR 视频生成扩展至长达一分钟的视频。 OmniForcing（Su 等，2026）是最接近的研究：它将同样的思路扩展到联合音频–视频领域，但采用多阶段链式结构——首先蒸馏一个双向少步生成器，再将其转换为自回归形式，这一顺序正是我们的 Chained-DA 以直接形式实现的版本。 该实现过程较为复杂，且这种顺序在表 1 中对应的是最弱的四步系统。 Causal Forcing（Zhu 等，2026）及其后续方法（Zhao 等，2026）则按相反顺序执行各阶段：首先训练一个多步自回归模型，最后利用一致性目标和分布匹配目标，在学生模型自身的生成结果上对其进行蒸馏；这正是我们的 Chained-AD 所遵循的实现方式。 其他研究则扩展或改进了分块自回归方法（Kim 等，2024；Henschel 等，2024；Chen 等，2025；Sand.ai，2025）；除 OmniForcing 外，这些方法均仅针对视频。

paragraphs.en: Model merging, surveyed by Yang et al. (2026) , combines independently fine-tuned models by arithmetic on their weights, e.g. task arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) , TIES ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) and DARE ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , and rests on weight disentanglement ( Ortiz-Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . For LoRA, OSRM ( Zhang and Zhou, 2025 ) imposes orthogonality on the subspaces before fine-tuning. In this work, two adapters are learned under heterogeneous conditions (bidirectional distillation vs. block-causal causalization) and edit different functional axes; they therefore tend to be near-orthogonal and add directly. Avatar-Forever ( Li et al., 2026 ) likewise trains two branches in parallel and merges them in weight space, but for audio-driven avatars, where the audio track is given rather than generated, and without any analysis of when the sum is safe.
paragraphs.zh: 模型合并（由 Yang 等人（2026）研究）通过对其权重进行算术运算来结合独立微调的模型，例如任务算术（Ilharco 等人，2023）、TIES（Yadav 等人，2023）和 DARE（Yu 等人，2024），其基础是权重的解耦（Ortiz-Jimenez 等人，2023；Jin 等人，2025）。对于 LoRA，OSRM（Zhang 和 Zhou，2025）在微调前对子空间施加正交性约束。在本研究中，两个适配器在异构条件下（双向蒸馏 vs. 块因果化）被学习，并且编辑不同的功能轴；因此它们倾向于接近正交并可直接相加。Avatar-Forever（Li 等人，2026）同样并行训练两个分支并在权重空间中合并它们，但这是针对音频驱动虚拟形象的场景，其中音频轨道是已给定的而非生成的，且未分析何时进行求和是安全的。

This undistilled model is the Teacher of Table 1 . The few-step adapter Δ d \Delta_{d} is off the shelf; the causal adapter Δ c \Delta_{c} is trained against the frozen backbone. Both are LoRAs, and they are added at inference.

paragraphs.en: In the chained routes, the training order of the adapters may result in different performance, as the second adapter is trained on the weights of W + Δ first W+\Delta_{\text{first}} .
paragraphs.zh: 在链式路由中，适配器的训练顺序可能会导致不同的性能表现，因为第二个适配器是在 W + Δ 的首个权重 W+\Delta_{\text{first}} 上进行训练的。

paragraphs.en: Chained-DA (distill, then causalize) fuses the public lightx2v Turbo LoRA ( lightx2v, 2026 ) , a third-party 4 4 -step distillation of W W , into the backbone, then trains a fresh causal adapter Δ c ′ \Delta_{c}^{\prime} on the distilled weights W ′ = W + Δ d W^{\prime}=W+\Delta_{d} by teacher forcing (§ 3.2 ) with the plain flow-matching objective of Eq. 3 .
paragraphs.zh: Chained-DA（先蒸馏，后因果化）将公开的 lightx2v Turbo LoRA（lightx2v，2026）——即 W W 的第三方 4 步蒸馏模型——融合到主干网络中，随后通过教师强制（§ 3.2），使用公式 3 中的简单流匹配目标，在蒸馏后的权重 W ′ = W + Δ d 上训练一个全新的因果适配器 Δ c ′ \Delta_{c}^{\prime}。

paragraphs.en: However, Δ d \Delta_{d} predicts where a large jump lands rather than the instantaneous velocity the teacher regresses, so W ′ W^{\prime} no longer minimizes the flow-matching objective; training Δ c ′ \Delta_{c}^{\prime} with that objective then pulls Δ d \Delta_{d} ’s jump field back toward instantaneous velocity and un-distills it—four steps may no longer suffice.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，Δ d \Delta_{d} 预测的是一个大跳跃的落点，而非教师模型所回归的瞬时速度，因此 W ′ W^{\prime} 不再能最小化流匹配目标；使用该目标训练 Δ c ′ \Delta_{c}^{\prime} 后，会将 Δ d \Delta_{d} 的跳跃场拉回瞬时速度，并使其失去蒸馏效果——此时仅靠四步可能已不再足够。

paragraphs.en: Chained-AD (causalize, then distill) keeps the causal stage against the frozen W W and distills the few-step property afterwards on the causal student itself, following the causal-forcing++ recipe ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) : training on the student’s own no-gradient rollouts, with consistency targets along the teacher’s Euler trajectory and a DMD stage (Appendix J ). The route is viable (§ 4.2 ), but it comprises three stages and three objectives, two of them entangled with the streaming cache, and the result is tied to the weights it was trained on.
paragraphs.zh: Chained-AD（先因果化，再蒸馏）使因果阶段保持与冻结的 W W 相对，随后在因果学生模型本身上进行少步特性蒸馏，遵循 causal-forcing++ 方案（Zhao 等，2026）：在学生模型自身的无梯度展开上进行训练，同时以教师模型的欧拉轨迹作为一致性目标，并包含一个 DMD 阶段（附录 J）。 该路线是可行的（§4.2），但它包含三个阶段和三个目标，其中两个与流式缓存相互交织，且最终结果依赖于其训练所用的权重。

paragraphs.en: The two chains thus differ in both order and objective, and both share two structural limitations. First, errors propagate along the chain: each adapter trains on what the previous one produced, so an early weakness becomes part of the next stage’s training environment. The un-distillation of Chained-DA is one instance; the anchor and online critic that Chained-AD needs to keep its rollouts stable is another. Second, a chained adapter cannot reuse existing components: the few-step capability of Chained-AD must be distilled on the causal model, where nothing off-the-shelf exists, and every chained adapter only works on the base it was trained on (§ 4.3 ). The parallel route removes both: each capability trains against the same frozen W W , so the two can be optimized independently and either side can be an existing component. We take the few-step adapter off the shelf and train only the causal one, a single plain regression (§ 3.2 ) with no ODE solver, EMA target, or critic. The rest of this section develops it.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这两条链在顺序和目标上均存在差异，且都共享两种结构性限制。 首先，错误会沿着链传播：每个适配器都以前一个适配器生成的结果进行训练，因此早期的弱点会成为下一阶段训练环境的一部分。 Chained-DA 未进行蒸馏是其中一个例子；而 Chained-AD 为保持其 rollout 稳定所需的锚点和在线评论员则是另一个例子。 其次，链式适配器无法复用现有组件：Chained-AD 的少数步能力必须在因果模型上进行蒸馏，而该模型中不存在任何现成组件，且每个链式适配器仅能基于其训练所用的基础模型运行（§ 4.3）。 并行路线则消除了这两个问题：每种能力都针对相同的冻结 W W 进行训练，因此两者可以独立优化，且任意一侧都可以是现有组件。 我们直接使用现成的少数步适配器，仅训练因果模型部分——这是一个没有 ODE 求解器、EMA 目标或评论员的单一普通回归任务（§ 3.2）。 本节的其余部分将对此展开详细阐述。

paragraphs.zh: 这是一个预测：在二阶近似下，添加两次更新的总成本等于它们的黑森交叉项；对于 H H -正交更新而言，该交叉项会消失（附录 E）。§4.3 证实了这一点，发现适配器虽然读取重叠的输入，但写入的方向却近乎正交——这种正交性是内在的，而非像 LoRA-合并方法（Zhang and Zhou, 2025）那样人为施加的。

paragraphs.en: The two adapters are combined by weight arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) : Δ d \Delta_{d} is fused into the backbone offline ( W ← W + B ​ A W\leftarrow W+BA ), and Δ c \Delta_{c} is loaded on top at inference, so Δ d \Delta_{d} adds no runtime overhead. One might expect failure— Δ d \Delta_{d} ’s trajectory was learned under full-sequence bidirectional attention, yet it now runs under a block-causal mask with history entering through a cache—but § 4.2 shows that four-step sampling still holds there. The streaming machinery below is shared by all causal configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个适配器通过权重算术（Ilharco 等人，2023）进行结合：Δ d \Delta_{d} 在离线阶段被融合到主干网络中（W ← W + B ​ A W\leftarrow W+BA），而 Δ c \Delta_{c} 则在推理时加载到其上方，因此 Δ d \Delta_{d} 不会增加运行时开销。 人们可能会预期出现失败——Δ d \Delta_{d} 的轨迹是在完整序列的双向注意力下学习的，但现在它却在一种块因果掩码下运行，历史信息通过缓存传入——但 §4.2 表明，四步采样在这种情况下仍然有效。 下方的流式处理机制被所有因果配置所共享。

paragraphs.en: Streaming generates one chunk at a time inside a sliding context window of at most N N chunks. Already-produced chunks stay frozen as context and, together with the encoded first-frame anchor, form the KV cache. Only the latest chunk goes through the DiT; it is emitted after denoising, and one extra forward writes its clean version into the cache. Every window starts at frame zero, so a chunk keeps the same absolute rotary positions wherever it appears and a cached key stays valid. Once the window holds N N chunks, the oldest chunk leaves while the first-frame anchor stays, so the per-chunk cost does not grow with session length (§ I ). The text prompt is the one part that is never cached. Teacher forcing lets it attend every clean chunk during training, while at inference each window re-encodes it and recomputes its keys alongside the current chunk, a negligible cost at ∼ 500 {\sim}500 tokens. The history it reads back was encoded under the earlier, shorter contexts of the windows that produced it; we accept this mismatch with training and call it the stale cache .
paragraphs.zh: 流式传输每次在最多包含 N 个分片的滑动上下文窗口中生成一个分片。 已生成的分片作为上下文保持固定，并与编码后的首帧锚点共同构成 KV 缓存。 只有最新分片会经过 DiT；它在去噪后被输出，而一次额外的前向传播会将它的干净版本写入缓存。 每个窗口都从第零帧开始，因此无论分片出现在何处，它都会保持相同的绝对旋转位置，且缓存的键仍然有效。 一旦窗口包含 N 个分片，最旧的分片会被移除，而首帧锚点则保留，因此每个分片的成本不会随会话长度增加（§ I）。 文本提示是唯一不会被缓存的部分。 教师强制机制允许它在训练期间关注每个干净的分片；而在推理阶段，每个窗口会重新编码它，并与当前分片一起重新计算其键，在约 500 {\sim}500 个词元时，这一成本可以忽略不计。 它所读取的历史信息是在生成它的窗口中较早、较短的上下文中编码的；我们接受这种与训练的不匹配，并将其称为“陈旧缓存”。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. We initialize our model from the official MiniMax-H3 FL2VA backbone and train it on avatar clips lasting 5 5 – 10 10 s in two resolution buckets, × 832 480\!\times\!832 and × 640 640\!\times\!640 (Appendix A ). The backbone stays frozen and both adapters are rank- 128 128 LoRAs ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . We do not train Δ d \Delta_{d} : it is the public lightx2v Turbo LoRA ( lightx2v, 2026 ) , which fixes the sampler at 4 4 steps. We train Δ c \Delta_{c} alone by clean-context teacher forcing on chunks of F = 34 F\!=\!34 frames, with AdamW at a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} on sixteen GPUs for two epochs. At inference, our method uses four denoising steps for each audio–video chunk with a context window of N = 7 N=7 chunks.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 我们从官方的 MiniMax-H3 FL2VA 主干模型初始化我们的模型，并在持续时间为 5 – 10 秒的虚拟形象片段上进行训练，这些片段分为两种分辨率：× 832 480\!\times\!832 和 × 640 640\!\times\!640（附录 A）。 主干模型保持冻结，两个适配器均为秩为 128 的 LoRA（Hu et al., 2022）。 我们不训练 Δ d \Delta_{d}：它使用的是公开的 lightx2v Turbo LoRA（lightx2v, 2026），该模型将采样器固定为 4 步。 我们单独训练 Δ c \Delta_{c}，通过干净上下文教师强制法对包含 F = 34 帧的片段进行训练，使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率恒定为 10^{-4}，在十六块 GPU 上训练两个周期。 在推理阶段，我们的方法为每个音频-视频片段使用四步去噪，上下文窗口为 N = 7 个片段。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol. We construct a held-out benchmark spanning both resolution buckets, two languages and a range of utterance lengths (Appendix A ). No test clip is seen during training. Comparative evaluations on this set are paired to the teacher’s own generation of the same clip, so reference and generation are comparable frame by frame. We further evaluate on three public talking-head sets — AVSpeech, HDTF and VidChatBench ( 100 100 clips each) — scored against the real source rather than the teacher, and on 30 30 s rollouts, with history capped by the sliding window. The held-out numbers measure fidelity to the teacher on unseen prompts and are not comparable with the public-set results. All systems share the same first-frame-conditioned audio–video setting.
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议。 我们构建了一个预留基准数据集，涵盖两个分辨率等级、两种语言以及多种话语长度（附录 A）。 训练过程中不会看到任何测试片段。 在该数据集上的对比评估会与教师模型对同一片段自身的生成结果进行配对，因此参考生成与生成结果可以逐帧比较。 我们进一步在三个公开的说话人脸数据集——AVSpeech、HDTF 和 VidChatBench（每个数据集包含 100 个片段）上进行评估，评估时以真实源数据而非教师模型为基准；此外还在 30 秒的连续生成任务中进行评估，历史输入通过滑动窗口进行限制。 预留数据集的数值衡量了模型在未见提示下对教师模型的忠实度，因此无法与公开数据集的结果进行比较。 所有系统均共享相同的以首帧为条件的音频-视频设置。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. The baselines all build on the same backbone W W and differ only in which adaptation they carry and in what order it was acquired. Teacher ( 50 50 -step, bidirectional) is a strong offline quality reference but cannot emit block-causally. Whole-seg ( W + Δ d W\!+\!\Delta_{d} , 4 4 -step) isolates distillation in its native bidirectional mode. The chained orders interleave the two adaptations instead of separating them: Chained-DA causalizes the distilled weights with a plain regression loss, while Chained-AD follows the causal-forcing order ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , for which we report the anchored checkpoint. Decoupled-50 serves our Δ c \Delta_{c} on the undistilled weights at 50 50 steps and is a reference point, not a step ablation. Our method is Decoupled ( W + Δ d + Δ c W\!+\!\Delta_{d}\!+\!\Delta_{c} , 4 4 -step, chunkwise). The columns of Table 1 form a ladder: Teacher → \to Whole-seg is distillation, Whole-seg → \to Decoupled is causalization with steps, shift, backbone and seed held fixed, and Decoupled → \to Chained-DA is chaining.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型。 所有基线模型都基于相同的骨干网络 W W，仅在其执行的适配类型以及获取该适配的顺序上存在差异。 Teacher（50步，双向）是一个强大的离线质量参考模型，但无法以因果阻塞方式生成输出。 Whole-seg（W + Δ d W\!+\!\Delta_{d}，4步）在其原生双向模式下将蒸馏过程独立处理。 链式顺序将两种适配交替进行，而非分开处理：Chained-DA 使用普通回归损失对蒸馏后的权重施加因果约束，而 Chained-AD 则遵循因果强制顺序（Zhu et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026），我们在此报告其锚定检查点。 Decoupled-50 在 50 步时将我们的 Δ c \Delta_{c} 应用于未蒸馏的权重，它是一个参考点，而非步骤消融实验。 我们的方法是 Decoupled（W + Δ d + Δ c W\!+\!\Delta_{d}\!+\!\Delta_{c}，4步，分块处理）。 表 1 的各列构成一个阶梯：Teacher → \to Whole-seg 是蒸馏过程；Whole-seg → \to Decoupled 是在保持步骤、偏移量、骨干网络和种子不变的情况下进行的因果约束；Decoupled → \to Chained-DA 则是链式处理。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Quality metrics are scored per clip and paired against the matching reference. Audio–video synchronization is measured by Sync-C ( ↑ \uparrow ) and Sync-D ( ↓ \downarrow ) for lip–speech alignment ( Chung and Zisserman, 2016 ) , and by AV-IB ( ↑ \uparrow ) ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) and DeSync ( ↓ \downarrow ) ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) for audio–video semantics. Visual quality uses IQA ( ↑ \uparrow , CLIP-IQA style ( Wang et al., 2023 ) on ViT-L/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) ) and ASE ( ↑ \uparrow ) ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) for appearance, CLIP ( ↑ \uparrow ) for prompt alignment, and CSIM ( ↑ \uparrow ), the cosine similarity of detected-face embeddings against the clip’s first frame, for identity. Intelligibility is scored from Qwen3-ASR-1.7B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) transcripts: WER ( ↓ \downarrow ) on English and CER ( ↓ \downarrow ) on Chinese. Long-horizon stability is reported as drift, the last window over the first, for IQA and CSIM. Table 1 reports these per-clip metrics; Sync-D, DeSync and CSIM-r (identity against the reference portrait, not the clip’s own first frame) enter the public-set comparison (Appendix G ). The set-level FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) and FAD ( Kilgour et al., 2019 ) are computed on the × 640 640\!\times\!640 bucket against unseen teacher output and quoted in the text beside their floor, so quality is the gap rather than an absolute value. Throughput, in frames per second (FPS) of end-to-end wall-clock time, is in Appendix I . Implementation controls are in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 质量指标按每个片段进行评分，并与匹配的参考片段进行比较。 音频与视频的同步性通过 Sync-C（↑ \uparrow）和 Sync-D（↓ \downarrow）衡量唇部与语音的对齐（Chung and Zisserman, 2016），并通过 AV-IB（↑ \uparrow）（Girdhar et al., 2023）和 DeSync（↓ \downarrow）（Iashin et al., 2024）衡量音频与视频的语义同步性。 视觉质量方面，外观使用 IQA（↑ \uparrow，CLIP-IQA 风格（Wang et al., 2023），基于 ViT-L/14（Radford et al., 2021））和 ASE（↑ \uparrow）（Schuhmann et al., 2022）进行评估；提示对齐使用 CLIP（↑ \uparrow）；身份识别则使用 CSIM（↑ \uparrow），即检测到的面部嵌入与片段第一帧之间的余弦相似度。 可理解性根据 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B（Qwen Team, 2025）的转录结果进行评分：英语使用 WER（↓ \downarrow），中文使用 CER（↓ \downarrow）。 长期稳定性以漂移形式报告，即最后一个窗口与第一个窗口之间的差异，分别针对 IQA 和 CSIM。 表 1 报告了这些按片段计算的指标；Sync-D、DeSync 和 CSIM-r（身份识别基于参考肖像，而非片段自身的第一帧）被纳入公开数据集的比较（附录 G）。 数据集级别的 FID（Heusel et al., 2017）、FVD（Unterthiner et al., 2018）和 FAD（Kilgour et al., 2019）在 × 640 640\!\times\!640 尺寸桶上，基于未见的教师模型输出计算，并在文本中引用其下限值，因此质量体现为差距而非绝对值。 吞吐量以每秒帧数（FPS）表示，反映端到端实际运行时间，详见附录 I。 实现控制相关细节见附录 D。

sents.en: Quality metrics are scored per clip and paired against the matching reference.
sents.zh: 质量指标按每个片段进行评分，并与匹配的参考片段进行比较。

sents.en: Audio–video synchronization is measured by Sync-C ( ↑ \uparrow ) and Sync-D ( ↓ \downarrow ) for lip–speech alignment ( Chung and Zisserman, 2016 ) , and by AV-IB ( ↑ \uparrow ) ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) and DeSync ( ↓ \downarrow ) ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) for audio–video semantics.
sents.zh: 音频与视频的同步性通过 Sync-C（↑ \uparrow）和 Sync-D（↓ \downarrow）衡量唇部与语音的对齐（Chung and Zisserman, 2016），并通过 AV-IB（↑ \uparrow）（Girdhar et al., 2023）和 DeSync（↓ \downarrow）（Iashin et al., 2024）衡量音频与视频的语义同步性。

sents.en: Visual quality uses IQA ( ↑ \uparrow , CLIP-IQA style ( Wang et al., 2023 ) on ViT-L/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) ) and ASE ( ↑ \uparrow ) ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) for appearance, CLIP ( ↑ \uparrow ) for prompt alignment, and CSIM ( ↑ \uparrow ), the cosine similarity of detected-face embeddings against the clip’s first frame, for identity.
sents.zh: 视觉质量方面，外观使用 IQA（↑ \uparrow，CLIP-IQA 风格（Wang et al., 2023），基于 ViT-L/14（Radford et al., 2021））和 ASE（↑ \uparrow）（Schuhmann et al., 2022）进行评估；提示对齐使用 CLIP（↑ \uparrow）；身份识别则使用 CSIM（↑ \uparrow），即检测到的面部嵌入与片段第一帧之间的余弦相似度。

sents.en: Intelligibility is scored from Qwen3-ASR-1.7B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) transcripts: WER ( ↓ \downarrow ) on English and CER ( ↓ \downarrow ) on Chinese.
sents.zh: 可理解性根据 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B（Qwen Team, 2025）的转录结果进行评分：英语使用 WER（↓ \downarrow），中文使用 CER（↓ \downarrow）。

sents.en: Long-horizon stability is reported as drift, the last window over the first, for IQA and CSIM.
sents.zh: 长期稳定性以漂移形式报告，即最后一个窗口与第一个窗口之间的差异，分别针对 IQA 和 CSIM。

sents.en: Table 1 reports these per-clip metrics; Sync-D, DeSync and CSIM-r (identity against the reference portrait, not the clip’s own first frame) enter the public-set comparison (Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 表 1 报告了这些按片段计算的指标；Sync-D、DeSync 和 CSIM-r（身份识别基于参考肖像，而非片段自身的第一帧）被纳入公开数据集的比较（附录 G）。

sents.en: The set-level FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) and FAD ( Kilgour et al., 2019 ) are computed on the × 640 640\!\times\!640 bucket against unseen teacher output and quoted in the text beside their floor, so quality is the gap rather than an absolute value.
sents.zh: 数据集级别的 FID（Heusel et al., 2017）、FVD（Unterthiner et al., 2018）和 FAD（Kilgour et al., 2019）在 × 640 640\!\times\!640 尺寸桶上，基于未见的教师模型输出计算，并在文本中引用其下限值，因此质量体现为差距而非绝对值。

sents.en: Throughput, in frames per second (FPS) of end-to-end wall-clock time, is in Appendix I .
sents.zh: 吞吐量以每秒帧数（FPS）表示，反映端到端实际运行时间，详见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: Audio–visual quality on the held-out benchmark. Table 1 collects the per-clip metrics, which we analyze from two perspectives. First, distillation alone: the bidirectional four-step Whole-seg stays within measurement noise of the 50 50 -step Teacher on nearly every metric (Sync-C 8.403 8.403 against 8.412 8.412 , identical AV-IB, IQA and ASE even slightly above the teacher), so “four steps is too few” explains none of the gaps that follow. Second, we compare the four-step autoregressive systems on appearance, synchronization and speech. Appearance. Decoupled keeps the image quality of Whole-seg (IQA 0.914 0.914 against 0.915 0.915 ), ahead of both chains ( 0.854 0.854 and 0.877 0.877 ), and holds identity best over the clip (CSIM drift 0.950 0.950 ); Chained-DA is slightly ahead on first-frame identity. Synchronization. This is the axis a chain wins: Chained-AD , which distills on the causal model itself, has the best lip sync (Sync-C 8.021 8.021 against our 7.443 7.443 ) and pays for it in appearance and identity; Decoupled stays well ahead of Chained-DA ( 6.389 6.389 ). Speech. Causalization costs most here. Every four-step causal system makes close to three times the word errors of Whole-seg (WER 0.126 0.126 – 0.136 0.136 against 0.047 0.047 ): chunkwise attention lets an audio token attend only the audio already generated, so the model must infer how far into the script it is from that alone. Decoupled matches the best chain on English (WER 0.127 0.127 against 0.126 0.126 and 0.136 0.136 ), has the lowest Chinese error rate (CER 0.051 0.051 against 0.061 0.061 for both chains), and keeps an audio distribution closer to the teacher than Chained-DA ’s (FAD 3.19 3.19 against 5.02 5.02 ).
paragraphs.zh: 保留测试基准上的视听质量。 表 1 汇总了每个剪辑片段的具体指标，我们从两个角度进行分析。 首先，仅使用蒸馏方法：双向四步 Whole-seg 在几乎所有指标上均未超出 50 步 Teacher 的测量噪声范围（Sync-C 为 8.403 对比 8.412，AV-IB、IQA 和 ASE 完全相同，甚至略高于 Teacher），因此“四步太少”这一说法无法解释后续出现的任何差距。 其次，我们从外观、同步和语音三个维度比较四步自回归系统。外观。 Decoupled 保持了 Whole-seg 的图像质量（IQA 为 0.914 对比 0.915），优于两种链式模型（分别为 0.854 和 0.877），并且在整个剪辑片段中身份一致性保持最佳（CSIM 漂移为 0.950）；Chained-DA 在第一帧的身份一致性上略胜一筹。同步。 这是链式模型占优的维度：Chained-AD 直接在因果模型上进行蒸馏，其唇部同步效果最佳（Sync-C 为 8.021 对比我们的 7.443），但代价是外观和身份一致性的下降；Decoupled 仍明显优于 Chained-DA（6.389 对比 6.389）。语音。 因果化在此处的代价最高。 所有四步因果系统的词错误率几乎是 Whole-seg 的三倍（WER 为 0.126–0.136 对比 0.047）：分块注意力机制导致音频标记只能关注已生成的音频内容，因此模型必须仅凭这些信息推断当前在脚本中的位置。 Decoupled 在英语上的词错误率与最佳链式模型相当（WER 为 0.127 对比 0.126 和 0.136），中文错误率最低（CER 为 0.051 对比两种链式模型的 0.061），并且其音频分布与 Teacher 的相似度高于 Chained-DA（FAD 为 3.19 对比 5.02）。

paragraphs.en: Further validation on public benchmarks. The held-out conclusions carry over to three public benchmarks ( 100 100 clips each), scored against the real source rather than the teacher (Table 4 , Appendix G ). Decoupled places first or second among the four autoregressive systems on nearly every scored column: IQA 0.866 0.866 / 0.866 0.866 / 0.892 0.892 on AVSpeech, VidChatBench and HDTF, ahead of every autoregressive baseline and of the 50 50 -step teacher on all three; the best autoregressive AV-IB on every set; and the lowest autoregressive FID and FVD on AVSpeech and VidChatBench.
paragraphs.zh: 在公开基准数据集上进行进一步验证。 预留测试集中的结论可推广至三个公开基准数据集（每个数据集包含 100 个剪辑），其评分依据真实源数据而非教师模型（表 4，附录 G）。 在所有评分列中，Decoupled 在四个自回归系统中几乎都排在第一或第二：在 AVSpeech、VidChatBench 和 HDTF 上，IQA 得分分别为 0.866 / 0.866 和 0.892 / 0.892，优于所有自回归基线模型以及这三个数据集上的 50 步教师模型；在每个数据集上都是表现最佳的自回归 AV-IB 模型；并且在 AVSpeech 和 VidChatBench 上具有最低的自回归 FID 和 FVD。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon analysis. What remains to be settled is whether composition survives extrapolation . We stream to 30 30 s, well past the 5 5 – 10 10 s clips the causal adapter was trained on, with no long-horizon training of any kind. We evaluate the resulting long-horizon behavior two ways — by endpoint change , scoring the closing window against the opening one, and by the full temporal trajectory , tracking first-frame similarity densely along the clip. Both use the same 40 40 clips, whose public-set transcripts we extend until each carries more script than 30 30 s of speech can deliver, so that every system is still mid-sentence when the video ends and none can be rewarded for simply stopping, and we generate the full 30 30 s with the history capped by the sliding window (one clip is shown in Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 长期预测分析。 尚未解决的问题是，组合性在预测外推时是否仍然成立。 我们将时间流延长至 30 秒，远超因果适配器训练所用的 5–10 秒片段，且未进行任何形式的长期预测训练。 我们通过两种方式评估由此产生的长期行为：一是通过终点变化，将结束窗口与起始窗口进行评分；二是通过完整的时间轨迹，沿片段密集追踪第一帧的相似性。 两种方法均使用相同的 40 个片段，我们将这些片段的公开数据集转录文本延长至每个片段包含的脚本内容超过 30 秒语音所能表达的量，以确保视频结束时所有系统仍处于句子中间，没有任何系统能因简单停止而获得奖励；同时，我们通过滑动窗口限制历史上下文（其中一个片段展示于图 2），生成完整的 30 秒内容。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports each metric over the final 5 5 -second window together with its relative change from the initial 5 5 seconds. Decoupled closes best on identity and image quality — 0.710 0.710 and 0.871 0.871 , the latter 2.6 % 2.6\% above its own opening — while Chained-AD arrives at 0.484 0.484 and 0.526 0.526 , having lost over a third of each, and Chained-DA keeps its face ( 0.683 0.683 ) but nearly halves its lip sync ( 3.75 3.75 , − 43.7 % -43.7\% ). The same holds for audio. Measured on raw samples, the closing amplitude drops only 10.6 % 10.6\% from its opening for Decoupled against 37.9 % 37.9\% for Chained-DA , which has largely fallen silent by the end. Two endpoints go against us: lip sync, where Chained-AD closes highest ( 7.82 7.82 against 5.69 5.69 ), and speaker identity, which falls furthest for Decoupled ( 0.521 0.521 , − 41.0 % -41.0\% ) and which § 5 reports as a limitation. The first-frame trajectories (Figure 3 ) show the same pattern: similarity to the first frame declines gradually under composition, with no late acceleration, while Chained-AD falls faster after 10 10 s and Chained-DA stays close to us in first-frame similarity, its cost showing in the audio and in image quality instead.
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了最后5秒窗口中各项指标的值，以及它们相对于初始5秒的相对变化。 Decoupled在身份识别和图像质量上的最终表现最佳——分别为0.710和0.871，后者比其初始值高出2.6%；而Chained-AD的最终结果则为0.484和0.526，两项指标均下降了三分之一以上；Chained-DA则保留了面部特征（0.683），但唇部同步效果几乎减半（3.75，下降43.7%）。 音频方面也是如此。 在原始样本上测量时，Decoupled的最终振幅仅比初始值下降了10.6%，而Chained-DA则下降了37.9%，到结束时几乎完全无声。 有两个终点指标与我们预期的结果相反：唇部同步方面，Chained-AD的最终表现最高（7.82，对比5.69）；而说话人身份识别方面，Decoupled的下降幅度最大（0.521，下降41.0%），这一点在§5中被列为局限性。 第一帧轨迹（图3）也呈现出相同的模式：在合成过程中，与第一帧的相似度逐渐下降，没有出现后期的加速现象；而Chained-AD在10秒后下降更快，Chained-DA在第一帧相似度上则与我们保持接近，其代价体现在音频和图像质量上。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we showed that block-causal attention and few-step sampling need not be learned in series. A causal adapter trained by clean-context teacher forcing against the frozen backbone, added at inference to an off-the-shelf few-step adapter, yields a few-step streaming audio–video model with no joint training and no orthogonality regularizer. The two updates write into near-orthogonal directions, as predicted from the functional axes they edit and as measured on the trained weights, which is why the sum is safe. Empirically, the composed model tracks the bidirectional teacher on appearance and holds quality over rollouts longer than the adaptation clips. The same causal adapter can be served on both the undistilled and the distilled weights. A natural next step is to test whether the same parallel composition holds on other joint audio–video generators.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们证明了块因果注意力和少步采样无需按顺序学习。 通过干净上下文教师强制训练、添加于冻结主干模型上的因果适配器，在推理时与现成的少步适配器结合使用，可生成一个无需联合训练且无需正交性正则化器的少步流式音频-视频模型。 这两种更新写入近乎正交的方向，这与它们所编辑的功能轴预测结果以及在训练权重上测得的结果一致，因此它们的求和是安全的。 从经验上看，组合模型在外观上能够跟踪双向教师模型，并且在推理过程中比适应片段更长时间地保持质量。 同一个因果适配器既可用于未蒸馏的权重，也可用于蒸馏后的权重。 一个自然的下一步是测试这种相同的并行组合方式是否也适用于其他联合音频-视频生成器。

paragraphs.en: Our training and test data come from a corpus of around 4000 4000 clips of 5 5 – 10 10 s. The clips are generated by MiniMax-H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) with its native 50 50 steps, using text prompts in talk-show and talking-head styles. paragraphs.en: Text rows are bidirectionally visible (Eq. 2 ), so training computes the text and every clean chunk in one forward pass: the text attends the whole clip, and each history key is produced in that full-clip context. Streaming cannot reproduce this. Each window re-encodes the text alongside the current chunk, which is cheap at ∼ 500 {\sim}500 tokens, but the history it reads from the cache was written by earlier, shorter windows, under texts that had seen less of the clip. A cached key is therefore stale in two ways: the text that helped encode it has moved on, and the context it aggregated was a window rather than the clip. The exact alternative is re-encoding the whole history at every window, which is the whole-segment cost the cache exists to avoid; we re-encode the cheap part and accept the staleness.
paragraphs.zh: 文本行是双向可见的（公式 2），因此训练时在一次前向传播中即可同时计算文本和每个干净片段：文本会关注整个剪辑，而每个历史键也是在该完整剪辑上下文中生成的。 流式处理无法复现这一效果。 每个窗口都会将文本与当前片段一同重新编码，这在约 500 {\sim}500 个词元的情况下成本较低；但其从缓存中读取的历史是由更早、更短的窗口在接触剪辑内容较少的文本时写入的。 因此，缓存中的键存在两方面过时的问题：帮助编码它的文本已经变化，而它聚合的上下文是一个窗口，而非整个剪辑。 确切的替代方案是在每个窗口中重新编码全部历史，而这正是缓存旨在避免的全段成本；我们选择重新编码成本较低的部分，并接受这种过时性。

paragraphs.en: This is the structure weight averaging exploits from the other side. Model soups ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) average multiple fine-tunes of one base and gain when those solutions share a basin in which the loss is locally near-convex — the linear mode connectivity observed for solutions of a common initialization ( Frankle et al., 2020 ) . Our updates differ in both respects: they are trained for heterogeneous objectives (bidirectional few-step distillation against block-causal causalization), and only one of them is trained at all — the other is taken off the shelf. No basin-sharing argument is available; what the sum needs is precisely that the cross-term be small, which is the quantity § 4.3 measures.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是结构加权平均从另一侧所利用的机制。 模型混合（Wortsman 等人，2022）对单一基础模型的多个微调版本进行平均，并在这些解共享一个损失函数局部近似凸的极小值域时获得增益——这正是共同初始化条件下解所表现出的线性模式连通性（Frankle 等人，2020）。 我们的更新在这两个方面都存在差异：它们针对异构目标进行训练（双向少步蒸馏对抗块因果建模），并且其中只有一个模型会真正接受训练——另一个则直接沿用现成版本。 目前尚无极小值域共享的论证可用；该求和项所需的关键条件恰恰是交叉项足够小，而这正是 §4.3 所度量的量。

sents.en: Model soups ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) average multiple fine-tunes of one base and gain when those solutions share a basin in which the loss is locally near-convex — the linear mode connectivity observed for solutions of a common initialization ( Frankle et al., 2020 ) .

sents.en: Our updates differ in both respects: they are trained for heterogeneous objectives (bidirectional few-step distillation against block-causal causalization), and only one of them is trained at all — the other is taken off the shelf.

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 is consistency distillation on the ground-truth cache: the student matches a nearby point on the frozen autoregressive teacher’s Euler trajectory. Stage 3 is distribution matching on self-forced rollouts, with a small MSE anchor of the supervised video chunk to the ground-truth latent. Without the anchor the critic absorbs high-frequency noise and stops penalizing it. For Table 3 the two distillation increments are merged into one update ( Δ c ​ d ⊕ Δ d ​ m ​ d \Delta_{cd}\oplus\Delta_{dmd} ).
